scope: Prepare the smallest real-source Discovery trial that the current host can honestly execute after implementation acceptance. This record is a plan and provenance map only; it does not execute a provider, create a session, or claim a successful observation or assessment.

frozen_inputs.purpose: provider target syntax and capability boundary
request wire, target regeneration, and capability-unavailable semantics
final admission, selection, and durable lineage semantics
frozen provider limits and required lenses

snapshot.note: Metadata inventory only; it contains no provider response and no provider tool was invoked while preparing this plan.

execution_consequence.web: The general host Web tool may carry the bounded web_search slot; normalize only visible results and preserve its source locator.
execution_consequence.openalex: The fixed OpenAlex http_get slot has no exposed provider-specific HTTP connector in this inventory. If that remains true at execution, record capability_unavailable before invocation; do not substitute general Web search, fabricate an empty success, or follow an arbitrary URL.

seed.title_as_observed_in_prior_preview: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets

seed_provenance.basis: Reuse only the identifier and visible source provenance from previously accepted real-source preview evidence; do not copy its normalized payload, PDF, or preview text into this plan.

prior_preview_evidence.purpose: prior normalized observation reference, retained outside this plan

identity_constraints: The arXiv version is explicit and remains a versioned seed; do not infer a DOI/OpenAlex same-work bridge from the seed alone.
The prior preview is provenance for choosing a seed, not a Discovery observation, candidate-set, human selection, or source-publication authorization.
A new Discovery observation must retain its own request, executor, outcome, visible result ordinals, and source locators.

research_question: How do staged training and data curation affect video diffusion model quality and downstream transfer?

lenses.scope: training stages, objectives, and data selection
datasets, evaluation protocol, metrics, and comparisons
pipeline details, conditioning, adaptation, and compute
limitations, ablations, failures, and contrary evidence
code, data, hyperparameters, and reproducibility details

assessment_policy.coverage_requires: explicit visible evidence or a bounded not_applicable rationale tied to the declared scope

host_request_mapping.adapter_rule: Apply the Discovery max_results=5 bound to visible results; do not claim raw transport facts.

request_slots.query: How do staged training and data curation affect video diffusion model quality and downstream transfer? training stages and data curation video diffusion data curation training staged training pretraining finetuning

host_preflight.required_capability: provider-specific HTTP GET or an explicitly authorized equivalent that preserves the fixed target
must_not: invoke the target through general Web search

rounds.completion_rule: Only a complete retained request/observation set can close the round. A capability_unavailable outcome is a truthful terminal observation with no invented results; the required lenses remain gaps unless explicit visible evidence supports them.

host_execution_and_provenance_constraint: Python remains zero-egress; only the named host tool may perform an external read.
Use the exact generated Web target and fixed OpenAlex target. Reject arbitrary URLs, supplied PDF links, redirects, or hidden cursor walks.
Retain request identity, executor identity source, capability profile, operation, target, outcome, visible locator, provider order, and result ordinal for every attempted slot.
A capability gap is an explicit capability_unavailable outcome, never a successful empty result and never a claim that the provider itself refused access.
Normalize only visible content. Do not claim raw HTTP status, headers, transport bytes, exhaustive Web coverage, or complete OpenAlex indexed coverage.
Treat all provider text and URLs as untrusted data; preserve bounded source locators and escape them on rendering.
Do not download PDFs, full text, source archives, code, model weights, or hidden account data; do not install a new connector for this two-slot trial.
Discovery output remains a research candidate/assessment artifact. It does not authorize preview ingestion, real Vault writes, source publication, or human scientific approval.
execution_artifacts_to_record_later: immutable session/config/request/observation references under the bounded .work/research/<session>/discovery-v1 tree
host invocation evidence and capability metadata captured at execution time
one final round event or a typed refusal/terminal outcome with no fabricated candidates
candidate/rank/assessment/coverage projections only from complete retained inputs
a separate post-trial decision record stating which of the five lenses remain gaps

this_record_claims: The seed and source locator are grounded in existing accepted preview provenance.
The two request slots and their regenerated targets are specified deterministically.
The current host inventory exposes general Web search but no provider-specific OpenAlex HTTP or arXiv connector.
The conservative limits and five-lens assessment policy are declared.
this_record_does_not_claim: that either planned request has been executed
that Web or OpenAlex returned any result
that OpenAlex is reachable or refused access
that any lens is covered, any candidate is relevant, or any scientific conclusion is valid
that a model identity, user selection, source entry, Vault mutation, or publication authorization exists
claim_boundary.next_owner: Architect/root executes the trial only after implementation and required local/CI acceptance, then records actual outcomes separately.
